original-en.context: IAGO. Why, there’s no remedy. ’Tis the curse of service, Preferment goes by letter and affection, And not by old gradation, where each second Stood heir to the first. Now sir, be judge yourself Whether I in any just term am affin’d To love the Moor.

modern-en.context: IAGO. Hate him? Hold me in contempt if I don't. Three important men in the city personally petitioned him to make me his lieutenant. They took off their hats to him. And by God, I know my worth — I deserve a place no worse than that. But he, in love with his own pride and his own plans, brushed them off with pompous, evasive talk, stuffed with military jargon. And in the end he dismissed my supporters. He said, “Truly, I have already chosen my officer.” And who was it? A bookkeeper, if you can believe it — one Michael Cassio, a Florentine, a man almost ruined by a beautiful wife. He's never led a squadron in the field, knows no more about how to deploy a battle than an old maid, except for the textbook theory that the togaed politicians can quote as expertly as he does. Pure talk, no practice — that's the whole of his soldiering. But he was the one chosen, sir. And I, whom Othello's own eyes have seen tested at Rhodes, at Cyprus, and on other ground, Christian and pagan, must be left becalmed by this calculator, this bean-counter. He, in good time, must be his lieutenant — and I, God help me, must be his Moorship's ensign.

original-en.context: OTHELLO. Let him do his spite; My services, which I have done the signiory, Shall out-tongue his complaints. ’Tis yet to know,— Which, when I know that boasting is an honour, I shall promulgate,—I fetch my life and being From men of royal siege. And my demerits May speak unbonneted to as proud a fortune As this that I have reach’d. For know, Iago, But that I love the gentle Desdemona, I would not my unhoused free condition Put into circumscription and confine For the sea’s worth. But look, what lights come yond?

modern-en.context: OTHELLO. Let him do his worst. The services I've done the Senate will speak louder than his complaints. It's not yet known — and when I find that boasting is honorable, I'll proclaim it — that I draw my life and being from men of royal lineage. And my own qualifications can stand bareheaded as an equal to as proud a fortune as the one I've reached. Because know this, Iago — if I didn't love the gentle Desdemona, I wouldn't give up my free, unsettled life for any treasure in the sea. But look — what lights are those coming over there?

Three great ones of the city, In personal suit to make me his lieutenant, Off-capp’d to him; and by the faith of man, I know my price, I am worth no worse a place. But he, as loving his own pride and purposes, Evades them, with a bombast circumstance, Horribly stuff’d with epithets of war: And in conclusion, Nonsuits my mediators: for “Certes,” says he, “I have already chose my officer.” And what was he? Forsooth, a great arithmetician, One Michael Cassio, a Florentine, A fellow almost damn’d in a fair wife, That never set a squadron in the field, Nor the division of a battle knows More than a spinster, unless the bookish theoric, Wherein the toged consuls can propose As masterly as he: mere prattle without practice Is all his soldiership. But he, sir, had the election, And I, of whom his eyes had seen the proof At Rhodes, at Cyprus, and on other grounds, Christian and heathen, must be belee’d and calm’d By debitor and creditor, this counter-caster, He, in good time, must his lieutenant be, And I, God bless the mark, his Moorship’s ancient.
